message.content:
An editorial illustration on a magazine cover features two caricatured human figures against a green background with stylised white clouds. On the left, a figure with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a red long-sleeved shirt, reclines backwards, extending their right arm upwards. On the right, a figure in a blue short-sleeved shirt and beige trousers floats among clouds, extending their left arm downwards. Their index fingers almost touch near the center.

The masthead reads "TEMPO" in large black letters. Above it are the phrases "Kartel Pinjaman Online H.68" and "Siapa Beking Kopral Bukit H.58". Below the title, the text "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears. To the left, large black text says "MEGAPRO BANGKIT LAGI," followed by a paragraph of smaller Indonesian text ending in "H.24". At the bottom, a barcode, a QR code, and text including "7-13 JULI 2025," "RP 60.000," "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN," and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" are visible. A red rectangular block occupies the top left corner.
